modules.purpose: A filesystem lease/lock so several processes on this one machine arbitrate contended resources: acquire/release/renew/status/list/check/commit/fence-op a named lease with a TTL. Atomic (CreateNew = open O_CREAT|O_EXCL), race-safe stale reclaim, holder identity + a lease_id token, blocking or non-blocking acquire. Conventional resources: gpu (one model run at a time), git (commit lock), doc:<path> (doc-ownership). v0.2 adds an ADDITIVE, DEFAULT-OFF fencing/handoff surface (a plain acquire is byte-identical to v0.1): a monotonic per-resource fencing token + CAS guard (finding 1), two lease kinds exec|residency_pin with fencing-backed priority revocation (finding 13), a prepared/evict-before-grant handoff over a pluggable evictor seam (findings 2/15), and lock-order-inversion rejection (finding 14). v0.3 (R1b) adds, still ADDITIVE + DEFAULT-OFF: THREE-IDENTITY fencing (gpu_authority_epoch = the per-resource fencing token, bumped only when exclusive GPU authority changes; resident_generation = the PoolManager-owned per-launch generation; exec_lease_id = the exec acquire's lease_id) with a full-tuple authority_ok assertion on check; the single scheduler-owned ATOMIC hand-off -Transition; an ADVERSARIAL mock evictor; and crash reconcile. v0.4 (R1b') folds the i19 red-team's BLOCKING primitive changes, still ADDITIVE + DEFAULT-OFF (a plain / v0.2 / v0.3 call is byte-identical): (1) ABA-closing INCARNATION identities -- owner_incarnation_id (random per owning-process RESTART) + resident_instance_id (random per server process TREE, the target of every destructive op, never resident_generation alone) -- folded into authority_ok so a restarted owner or a stale-instance callback is fenced out; (2) a TWO-PHASE transition (-TwoPhaseCommit then -Action commit) that issues a NON-USABLE transition capability and publishes the first USABLE exec lease only AFTER health -- no ordinary exec authority before the resident is healthy + published (blocker 1); (3) -Action fence-op, the TARGET-FENCED side-effect gate an external stop/kill/publish/release must pass (it MUST name an exact resident_instance_id -- 'stop whatever serves this resource' is impossible); (4) an idempotent, red-team-field txn journal + request_id COMMIT-RESPONSE idempotency (a retry returns the SAME grant, never a 2nd epoch/lease/resident); (5) an oplock-serialized renew so a renewal can NEVER resurrect a revoked lease; (6) a durable per-resource state_version for waiter sequencing. res.lease stays PURE (never inspects VRAM / kills a server); the real supervisor + health + the LIVE proof are the later #7 consumer wave. The multi-instance coordination primitive.

modules.purpose: Fuse the per-source video artifacts of the Phase C spine -- media meta (#32), scenes (#32), the reviewed sample manifest, reviewed-schema identity tracks (#33 upgrade), transcript segments (#11), OCR lines (#14), and per-sample detections (#16) -- into ONE canonical, deterministic, searchable timeline JSON (lifeorch.video_timeline/0.1). Every provided input is validated STRICTLY; violations produce a fail-closed error envelope enumerating each one. The timeline carries coverage (the sample manifest -- 'sampled with no detection' vs 'not sampled' stay distinguishable), normalized scenes, per-track APPEARANCE SEGMENTATION intervals (contiguous observed spans split at recorded gaps with separated detection/association evidence; gaps are first-class track_gap intervals; spans are NEVER merged across a gap), events (speech/ocr_text/detection_sample/scene_cut, content-canonically sorted), an index (by_class/by_track/by_scene/by_kind with stable positional refs), and a summary. identity_scope is carried verbatim; NO field named 'confidence' appears in the canonical output. modules.purpose: The Collective Agent's authoritative catalog + memory-record substrate (D-0080 Wave 1/2, arch position 23), built to the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT (D-0083). A stdlib-only Python worker (artifact_search.py) owns a SQLite database (sources / documents / document_versions / chunks + records / record_edges + vectors + FTS5) with full provenance. 0.2 adopts the MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 record+provenance ENVELOPE, adds the generic 'ingest_records' SINK so Wave-2 producers (repo.intel #38, episode.memory #39) can land TYPED records (symbol/relationship/episode/failure/summary/...) not chunks, and forward-migrates a shipped-0.1 db in place. modules.purpose: A common interface for local and frontier agents to run local models on this machine. MVP runs local LLMs (GGUF text) through the built llama.cpp llama-server, selected from a declarative registry (models.json) by model id or tier alias. The registry also declares STT/TTS/embedding models (staged, but wired in their own later modules). First stochastic/mixed skill: records full model_provenance and a generation-completeness confidence. Governor Phase 3 Stage-1.1 (D-0067): the named warm POOL MANAGER (mechanism C) is HARDENED so it can be enabled by default. Integrity core (lib/PoolManager.psm1, unit-tested): reuse vs reload is decided by CanServe(resident,request) -- exact on semantic identity, '>=' on capacity (a 32K/9B resident serves a 16K/M0 request); a deterministic resident_config_hash (hashes model+engine-exe CONTENTS, not paths) is split from a per-launch instance_generation nonce; residency is a crash-atomic state machine EMPTY->STOPPING->EMPTY_CONFIRMED->STARTING->RESIDENT (atomic replace) reconciled on every startup under a machine-global lock; a monotonic fence + short renewable TTL is the authority, and an inference call carrying -ExpectGeneration/-ExpectFence is REJECTED on mismatch (no wrong-generation call lands); the resident is proven by the listening SOCKET OWNER (not a /v1/models alias); -PrepareGpu evicts-before-grant for a GPU handoff (no blind co-load); LRU + the timed idle-unload are removed from the correctness path and same-model prefix reuse is dropped (KV isolation = erase-on-checkout/check-in). The pool is an OPTIONAL layer (-BypassPoolManager forces the classic cold isolated-server path); integrity invariants are non-bypassable. Default OFF -> the classic per-call + D-0057 warm paths are byte-for-byte unchanged. Stage-1.1 residual (a) durable finding 5: a companion DURABLE gateway supervisor (Start-GatewaySupervisor.ps1 + lib/Supervisor.psm1) is the PERSISTENT process that owns the resident llama-server tree in a Windows Job Object (JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, P/Invoke) so residency + tree ownership SURVIVE across per-call invocations; per-call gateways ATTACH over a file-protocol control channel (runtime/supervisor/control/) and reuse the resident (~1 ms, no respawn) via -UseSupervisor, degrading to the per-call path if no supervisor is live. The supervisor is the single owner running the PoolManager transitions; the Job Object reaps the whole tree if the supervisor dies; on restart it reconciles the published manifest as a claim to VERIFY. Pool STILL DEFAULT-OFF this wave (enable-by-default awaits a soak + the res.lease fencing wave, findings 13/14). v0.5.0 (i21, the R1b CONSUMER wave) adds the DEFAULT-OFF GPU-lease-split adoption of res.lease 0.4.x (-UsePoolLeaseSplit): a revocable residency_pin held BETWEEN calls (priority = tier), a plain short exec re-attach around a same-model reuse, every swap/load through the v0.4 TWO-PHASE transition (-Transition -TwoPhaseCommit -> non-usable capability -> start -> '-Action commit -HealthOk' AFTER health; -HealthFailed drops the exact tentative instance and leaves the GPU EMPTY) driving the REAL supervisor-routed nvidia-smi evictor lib/PoolEvictor.ps1 (-EvictorMode command; every destructive step names the exact resident_instance_id and consults '-Action fence-op' first; NEVER a PID kill), the FULL v0.4 tuple (owner_id + owner_incarnation_id + gpu_authority_epoch + resident_generation + resident_instance_id + exec_lease_id) asserted BEFORE and re-asserted AFTER every completion (a stale in-flight result is DISCARDED), and a supervisor-side TARGET-FENCED evict (a targeted stop must name the manifest's exact resident_instance_id). OFF == the classic + D-0057 warm + Stage-1.1 pool + supervisor paths byte-for-byte. v0.6.0 (i23, the SUPERVISOR-HARDENING wave) folds the i21 frontier red-team's 10 must-fixes into the DEFAULT-OFF durable supervisor + integrity layer + real evictor (additive; every default path byte-for-byte unchanged): PER-RESIDENT SUSPENDED-CREATE JOB CUSTODY (CreateProcess CREATE_SUSPENDED -> AssignProcessToJobObject -> IsProcessInJob verify -> ResumeThread; the supervisor holds each per-resident KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE handle; NO child runs before it is in its job; job-assignment failure is FATAL on the Windows path -- no uncustodied publish; tree_gone = per-resident Job zero-members); a LIFETIME SUPERVISOR SINGLETON (named mutex, a second supervisor exits); AUTHENTICATED IPC (strict request_id + path containment, idempotent replay guard, generation binding, a separate authenticated admin shutdown); NO launch after a failed/partial evict or a failed CAS (fail-closed, GPU left ungranted, manifest not cleared); an ABANDONMENT-AWARE pool lock with a nonce'd release (no time-bound steal of a live owner); HARD nvidia-smi probe deadlines (pinned absolute path, kill-on-timeout -> unknown -> confirmed:false) + unmanaged_vram_pressure (never a blind kill); HEARTBEAT-STALE => UNRESPONSIVE with NO live-but-unresponsive fallback (the client fails closed instead of spawning a split-brain second server); RESTART reconcile that never adopts a manifest-only survivor (adopt only via a retained custodian); and REAL pre-launch content verification (sha256 vs a trusted expected-hash manifest, reparse-point rejection). Residuals (named): the grown soak, the in-proc res.lease client, the exec.watchdog #00.1 supervisor-relaunch driver, and the ACL'd app-data state relocation + trusted-hash provisioning.

modules.purpose: Run an escalating ladder of local model tiers (tiny 0.5B -> weak 1.5B -> mid 3B -> strong 27B, all via model.gateway) over a batch of tasks. The weakest tier answers; each higher tier judges the current answer and either accepts it (stop -- the accepted layer is the tier that produced the current answer) or produces its own answer for the next tier to judge; the top tier's answer is accepted if reached. Every rung is anchored with DETERMINISTIC ground-truth gates (in-set membership for classify; JSON-schema validity + source grounding for extract; self-consistency across samples) so the ladder never rests on LLM-judges-LLM alone: a hard-fail overrides an LLM-judge ACCEPT (anti-rubber-stamp) and strong self-consistency accepts without a judge (cost saver). Generalizes review.processor (#9) + route.tasks (#24); the cost-offload keystone -- every task a low tier finishes end-to-end is one the frontier allotment never pays for. modules.purpose: A bounded, ReAct-style LOCAL agent loop: given a natural-language goal it decides which Module (tool) to call, generates that tool's arguments, invokes it, observes the result, and repeats until the goal is finished or a hard step budget is reached. It is the frontier agent's tool loop done locally, to offload orchestration off the scarce weekly frontier allotment. DECISIONS ('which tool next, or finish?') route THROUGH logic.escalator (#19) as a closed-set classify task (labels = the registered tool names + 'finish'), so the escalator's deterministic in-set gate guarantees a valid action and its tiny->weak->mid ladder does the cost-offload; ARGUMENT GENERATION and the FINAL ANSWER use model.gateway (#7); TOOLS are conforming Modules invoked as child skills (the image.index #18 spawn-and-parse-envelope pattern) from a curated declarative closed registry (tools.json; ships doc.io/fs.observer/capture.screen/ocr.layout/detect.objects/image.interpret/speech.stt/audio.ingest/gen.image/gen.music/fs.manage). A tool may set resolve_paths:false (e.g. fs.manage) to receive its path arguments verbatim (so known folders like 'desktop', ~, and %ENV% survive); otherwise relative path-like args are resolved against working_dir. With -Route, route.tools (#27) is called FIRST to pre-select the minimal toolset for the goal and the ReAct loop is CONSTRAINED to that subset (falling back to the full set if the router returns nothing); the selection is surfaced as result.planned_tools. Guardrails: a hard max_steps budget, a -DryRun plan-preview that invokes nothing, and needs_frontier surfaced as a status field. ORCHESTRATOR, NOT a review-queue producer: it redirects every child's review writes to an in-artifact child_review.jsonl and never writes the canonical review_queue.jsonl. OPT-IN Governor Phase 3 mode (-AutoRamp, OFF by default; existing behavior byte-for-byte unchanged) delegates to Invoke-AutoRamp.ps1: MONOTONIC MODEL-AFFINE EPOCHS (M0 3B floor decide=[mid] 768tok -> M1 one fresh-context expanded-mid retry on the SAME 3B 1536tok -> S0 escalate the WHOLE epoch to the resident 9B decide=[strong] as a DIRECT one-rung classify 2048tok; never de-escalate within a task), driven by a caller-supplied PRE-FROZEN deterministic success contract (schema lifeorch.goal_verification/0.1; predicates file_exists/artifact_exists/artifact_nonempty/sha256_equals_source/json_schema_valid/command_exit_zero/state_version_changed/value_equals/all_required_tool_postconditions_passed), a WHOLE-TASK gpu lease (acquire once, renew ~30s), and an EXACT resident-model residency check over the model.gateway warm server (reuse only on a whole-key match, else evict+reload). HARD triggers (empty/malformed/out-of-set/length-truncated decision, finish-but-contract-fails, repeat-identical-action-no-state-change, stale/wrong resident) escalate immediately to S0; a >=2-strike-in-3-steps soft accumulator uses M1 once before the reload; a task-scoped idempotency key refuses exact-duplicate mutations and resumes from the last authoritative state across epochs. Returns verified_success ONLY when the SAME frozen contract passes (never the model's say-so), else completed_unverified / human_verification_required / local_ceiling_reached / time_budget_exhausted; emits a machine-checkable governor-trace artifact. EXCLUDED from this Stage-1 slice: X0/27B, logprobs/entropy, self-consistency, pattern-learning. v0.2.0 (i21, the R1b CONSUMER wave) adds the DEFAULT-OFF -SplitLease governor adoption of the GPU-lease split (res.lease 0.4.x): the -AutoRamp model-affine segment holds a revocable residency_pin (priority = tier; the renew path re-attaches across its own child gateway's swaps) instead of the whole-task gpu lease, and the exec lease is taken only around each LLM call BY THE GATEWAY (use_pool_lease_split + split_priority + a per-run owner_incarnation_id threaded through so the full v0.4 tuple is asserted per call). OFF == byte-for-byte, including the $env:LIFEORCH_INSTANCE stable-holder re-attach.
